body_html:
"County Solid Waste Regulations" are the regulations adopted by County for the purpose of governing solid waste management in Johnson County, Kansas, and which are entitled and sometime referred to as the Johnson County Code of Regulations for Solid Waste Management, 2010 Edition (as may be amended from time to time).

(History: Ord. SW-2927 §7, 2011)
